description:
Google News Scraper: search, topics and local news as JSON

Google News as JSON from search queries (with operators like when:7d and site:), topic feeds and local feeds: headline, publisher, resolved publisher URL, publish time, source domain and related stories. No browser, no API key. From $1.00 per 1,000 articles.

Pricing (pay per event, billed to your Apify account): Article scraped: $0.001.

Runs on Apify as subimpact/google-news-rss-scraper.

_maxChargeUsd.description: Per-run spending cap in USD (default 0.5). Passed to Apify as the run option maxTotalChargeUsd, so the run stops when it reaches this charge.
_maxChargeUsd.title: Max charge (USD)

_maxItems.description: How many dataset items to return to the model (1-1000, default 50). Truncates the response only; it does not change what the Actor collects or charges for.
_maxItems.title: Max items returned

country.description: Two-letter country code for the Google News edition, e.g. US, MY, SG, GB, ID. Copied to each row as country. Together with the language it forms Google's ceid parameter (MY + en-MY -> MY:en).
country.title: Country (gl)

geos.description: Place names for Google News geo feeds, e.g. Malaysia, Penang, Singapore, London. Google only resolves places it knows for the chosen country, so a run with no matching place returns an Empty row (not charged).
geos.title: Geo headlines (places)

language.description: Google interface locale, e.g. en-US, en-GB, en-MY, ms-MY, id, pt-BR, zh-CN. It selects the edition language of every feed and is copied to each row as language.
language.title: Language (hl)

maxArticlesPerFeed.description: Rows taken from each feed, in the order Google ranks them. Google's RSS returns at most ~100 items per feed, so 100 means everything.
maxArticlesPerFeed.title: Max articles per feed

maxItems.description: Hard cap on delivered article rows for the whole run. Counting stops at rows actually delivered, so a run never goes over the cap.
maxItems.title: Max rows per run

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Plain HTTP works and is the default; switch on Apify Proxy if Google starts rate-limiting your runs or if you need a specific country's News edition.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

queries.description: Google News search queries, one feed each. Google's own search operators work: quotes for an exact phrase, site:reuters.com to restrict a publisher, when:7d or when:1h for recency, AND / OR / -term. Example: "electric vehicles" site:reuters.com when:7d
queries.title: Search queries

resolveUrls.description: Follow each news.google.com/rss/articles/<id> link through Google's public batchexecute endpoint to the real publisher URL. Costs one extra Google request per article and takes a few seconds per 100 rows; turn it off for a faster, cheaper metadata-only run (publisherUrl stays null, googleNewsUrl is always kept).
resolveUrls.title: Resolve publisher URLs

topics.description: Google News topic feeds: the same headlines Google News shows on its topic pages, each story with the cluster of articles covering it.
topics.title: Topic headlines

name: google_news_rss
